item.title: Review: The religious beliefs of a hospital operator should not determine the healthcare available to Australians | Nisha Khot
item.description: Women suffer the consequences when Catholic healthcare providers acquire hospitals and create geographic deserts for abortion, contraception and IVF In 2012 in Ireland, Dr Savita Halappanavar, who was then 17 weeks pregnant, attended a hospital with back pain. An examination found the pregnancy sac protruding through her womb.
